business_summary: Ksolves India Limited provides software development services in North America, India, Europe, Australia, and internationally. The company offers Dashboard Ninja with AI, Ksolves Cloud, Access Manager Ninja, Hotel Management, ReportMate, Advanced Dashboard Ninja, and Odoo WooCommerce Connector; SMS Ninja, Google Analytics Connector, and Salesforce CTI Integration; Mind AI Ninja; Data Flow Manager; and Ksolves Cloud Agent. It also provides artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning services, including AI strategy and consulting, machine learning model development, predictive analytics and forecasting, natural language processing, computer vision, AI for business process automation, AI on cloud and edge, AI risk, ethics, and compliance consulting; big data consulting, implementation, integration, management, analytics, and support services; and SnowFlake and Databricks consulting services. In addition, the company offers Salesforce and Odoo services; RFP consulting; cybersecurity services, such as transaction monitoring and screening, compliance and regulatory framework, cybersecurity consulting services, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, managed cybersecurity services, and disaster recovery and business continuity; and microservices development, Openshift, UiPath, Java, penetration testing, performance testing, test automation, iOS application development, android application development, ReactJS Development, Node.js application development, ERPNext, angular development, blockchain development, quantum computing, and ServiceNow. Further, it provides streaming and messaging, storage and databases, compute and query engines, lakehouse and analytics, Ops and observability, and governance and security. It serves telecom, services, information technology, retail, BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare, edutech, real estate, and marketing and advertising industries. Ksolves India Limited was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
